expected.headline: 《逃离塔克夫》：《逃离塔科夫》1.3.0更新上线，Unity 6引擎迁移暂缓
expected.summary: Battlestate Games为《逃离塔科夫》部署1.3.0更新与万圣节活动；原计划随本次更新进行的Unity 6引擎迁移未按期实施，现有版本仍基于Unity 2022.3。

replacement.headline: 《逃离塔克夫》启动1.3.0更新维护，Unity 6引擎迁移暂缓
replacement.summary: Battlestate Games为《逃离塔克夫》1.3.0更新及万圣节活动启动安装维护；原计划随本次更新进行的Unity 6引擎迁移暂缓，现有版本仍基于Unity 2022.3。

englishExpected.headline: Escape from Tarkov update 1.3.0 goes live, while the Unity 6 migration is deferred
englishExpected.summary: Battlestate Games has deployed Escape from Tarkov update 1.3.0 and its Halloween event. The planned migration to Unity 6 did not take place with this update; the current version remains based on Unity 2022.3.

englishReplacement.headline: Escape from Tarkov begins maintenance for update 1.3.0 as Unity 6 migration is deferred
englishReplacement.summary: Battlestate Games has begun installation maintenance for Escape from Tarkov update 1.3.0 and its Halloween event. The planned migration to Unity 6 has been deferred from this update; the current version remains based on Unity 2022.3.
